description: Replaces the body content of a Google Docs tab with rendered Markdown; requires edit permissions. If no tab is specified, the first tab is updated.

input_parameters.title: UpdateDocumentMarkdownRequest

id.title: Id
id.description: The unique identifier for the Google Docs document to update. Accepts either a document ID (alphanumeric string, length varies by document age - newer documents typically have 44-character IDs) or a full Google Docs URL (e.g., https://docs.google.com/document/d/{DOCUMENT_ID}/edit). When a URL is provided, the document ID will be automatically extracted.
id.human_parameter_description: The unique identifier or URL of the Google Docs document you want to update. You can paste either the document ID or the full Google Docs URL - the ID will be extracted automatically.

tab_id.title: Tab Id
tab_id.description: Optional tab ID to replace with the rendered Markdown. When omitted, the first tab is updated.

WriteControl.title: WriteControl

targetRevisionId.title: Target Revision Id
targetRevisionId.description: The target revision ID of the document that the write request was applied to. If collaborator changes occurred after the document was read, changes from this write request will be transformed against the collaborator changes, resulting in a new revision that incorporates both sets of changes.

requiredRevisionId.title: Required Revision Id
requiredRevisionId.description: The revision ID of the document that the write request was applied to. If this is not the latest revision of the document, the request will not be processed and will return a 400 bad request error.

WriteControl.description:
Write control information after applying the request.
Only one of requiredRevisionId or targetRevisionId should be set.
